phases.label: Installation
phases.reason:
We will install:
  - validate product foundations: loctree and aicx stay product-managed
  - install or validate framework-owned support tools when needed
  - frontier agent configuration
  - shared skills, launchers, and mirrored agent views
  - the selected runtime horse when RUNTIME=... is provided
  - the Python CLI and MCP packages through uv tool install
  - the vendored foundation binaries from bin/vendor/<platform> when the bundle carries them
  - the Rust app/server binaries (voc, vc-admin, vc-server) as real files in ~/.local/bin
reasonLines: We will install:
- validate product foundations: loctree and aicx stay product-managed
- install or validate framework-owned support tools when needed
- frontier agent configuration
- shared skills, launchers, and mirrored agent views
- the selected runtime horse when RUNTIME=... is provided
- the Python CLI and MCP packages through uv tool install
- the vendored foundation binaries from bin/vendor/<platform> when the bundle carries them
- the Rust app/server binaries (voc, vc-admin, vc-server) as real files in ~/.local/bin
commands:
bash -e -c 'bash scripts/install-foundations.sh
bash "$PWD/vibecrafted-core/vibecrafted_core/runtime/scripts/install-frontier-config.sh" --source "$PWD" || printf '"'"'[warn] Frontier config skipped (non-fatal)\n'"'"'
python3 scripts/vetcoders_install.py install --source "." --compact --non-interactive --mirror
bash scripts/install-runtime.sh --runtime "${VIBECRAFTED_RUNTIME:-none}" --yes
make --no-print-directory install-python-tools
make --no-print-directory install-vendored-binaries
make --no-print-directory install-app-binaries
make --no-print-directory install-server
'
